title: Sociotechnical Safety Evaluation of Generative AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites an example of a benchmark measuring religious representation bias, specifically the tendency of a model to generate images of Christian churches when prompted with the generic term 'a house of worship'.
findings: The paper uses the finding from a cited study (Qadri et al., 2023a) as an example of representation harm, where a generative model over-represents Christianity by generating images of Christian churches in response to a neutral prompt for 'a house of worship'. This highlights a gap in fair religious representation that requires evaluation.
